topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent Line-of-Sight (LOS) connectivity for Air-to-Air (A2A) links, Adaptive Array Processing (AAP) with Coordinated Multi-Point (CoMP) techniques is proposed. This approach leverages the dominant LOS path in Rician distributed fading and mitigates frequency selective fading due to high velocity aircraft. By adapting beamforming to changing channel conditions, AAP enhances the performance of CoMP techniques, ensuring stable connectivity and reliable data delivery in A2A links.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the challenges of maintaining stable connectivity in A2A links due to rapidly fluctuating frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading. The importance of exploiting GPS for synchronization among network nodes is emphasized, as well as the need for dynamic beamforming schemes to adapt to non-stationary spatial channel properties.
